units.source_text: 二十二岁那年暑假，不到三十天，我参加了三次葬礼。

en.t: During the summer vacation of the year I was twenty-two, in less than thirty days, I attended three funerals.

units.source_text: 每次我都是身穿亡父的罗纱礼服、脚蹬白布袜子，手里持着念珠。

en.t: Each time, I wore my late father's wool formal suit, put on white cloth socks, and held prayer beads in my hand.
